## About
At APEX HOME, our mission is to change lives one home at a time with healthy home solutions. Our Multi-Layer Insulation approach brings together attic sealing, insulating, ventilation systems, solar sun lights and air purification, so your home is more energy efficient, comfortable and healthy.
It all starts in the attic. Our trained experts take the guesswork out of home sealing and seal every area of your home affected by hot or cold air transfer. We also focus on keeping formaldehyde out, and every part and component we use is made in America.
Our core values are respect, integrity and care for others. A reviewer said Steven measured their home and took his time with them, and another said Corey gave a great presentation.

## Services
- Solar Attic Ventilation: Solar attic fans that keep your attic temperature under control. A properly ventilated attic saves on energy bills and is necessary for structural integrity.
- Attic Sealing: We properly seal every area of your home affected by hot or cold air transfer.
- Multi-Layer Insulation (MLI): Our approach of attic sealing, insulating, ventilation systems, solar sun lights and air purification working together.
- Basement insulation: Insulation below the house as well as above it.
- Air purification: Clean air solutions to help protect your family. A reviewer whose husband has asthma said they are now breathing clean air.
- Solar sun lights: Part of our Multi-Layer Insulation approach to a more comfortable, energy efficient home.

## FAQ
Q: What is MLI?
A: MLI stands for Multi-Layer Insulation. It is our approach of attic sealing, insulating, ventilation systems, solar sun lights and air purification, all working together to make your home more energy efficient, comfortable and healthy.

Q: Is there a warranty on the solar attic fans?
A: Yes. We offer a lifetime warranty on attic solar fans.

Q: Why start with the attic?
A: Keeping the proper amount of insulation in your attic keeps its temperature under control. A properly ventilated attic saves on energy bills and is necessary for structural integrity.

Q: When can I reach you?
A: We are open Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM, and closed on weekends.
